title: Beginner VS Pro Meta Advertisers
transcript: What's the biggest difference between pro and beginner meta advertisers? Beginner meta advertisers are far too reactionary and emotionally tied up in their campaigns. I've seen many beginner advertisers where their entire mood and state of being is dictated by what their return on ad spend has been that day so far. Pro advertisers understand that things take longer. They give things more stability. They also play the game differently, so professional advertisers will often sacrifice short term return on ad spend 4 scale. That might mean paying more to acquire a customer, not less. But knowing that you make it up in customer lifetime value, you make it up in referrals because your product or service is so good. So often. The best advertisers don't achieve the best return on ad spend numbers, but they very often operate at the largest scale.
